notes: Checked against the book's own Colophon (second edition, (c) 2012-2025 Matthew Boelkins) and the project's home page. CC BY-SA 4.0 allows commercial use, so a paid app may show a passage with the credit in attribution; what Ceder changes stays under the same licence. The first edition (/single1e/) carries the same CC BY-SA 4.0 statement; the 2nd edition is what /single/ serves. The older AIM listing claim of CC BY-NC-SA was not found on the book itself. Not checked: individual figures and photographs (the first edition's colophon credits a cover photo to James Haefner Photography), and the interactive WeBWorK exercises, which run on a separate WeBWorK server and whose problem code was not read. The colophon says trademarks belong to their owners. No separate terms-of-use page was found on activecalculus.org. LibreTexts copies of the book were not read and are not covered. The bank's agents don't read it and nothing from it goes into the bank.
